summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Voiladi chat room composer UI fixes. All critical features verified: floating glass composer with correct translucent gradient (86%->72% white), flat blue '+' button with no box-shadow, legible input over black bubbles (82% white), focus expansion behavior, auto-scroll to bottom, and bot auto-reply functionality. All tests passed successfully.
passed_tests: Login via API with test credentials (arin.landing@voiladi.com) and localStorage token storage
Navigation to /chats and opening chat thread with Sofia
Composer visibility with side margins (16px left/right, not full-width strip)
Composer translucent white gradient background: rgba(255,255,255,0.86) to rgba(255,255,255,0.72)
Plus button (+) renders as clean 40x40px blue circle with box-shadow: none (no clipped artifacts)
Plus button click opens file input [data-testid=chat-media-input]
